weapons.title: Weapons and progression
paragraphs: Weapons grant stats, passive abilities, and a Weapon Skill in addition to the equipping character’s own skills. Weapon-type compatibility and individual restrictions still apply. The Main Character can equip any weapon type, changing the Basic Skill accordingly.
The design specifies a +0.08 multiplier per level, reaching an eightfold increase at level 100. Individual item cards list the exact level 1 and level 100 values recorded in the document.

Each weapon star improves its Weapon Skill and passive values by +10%. Additional duplicates beyond the main star levels improve weapon stats by 0.5%, subject to a cap that has not yet been specified.

accessories.title: Accessories
paragraphs: Accessories don’t have any distinct skills attached but have buffs and passives that additionally help to buff a character.

artifacts.title: Artifact stats and set rules
paragraphs: Artifact sets have four pieces, with bonuses for equipping two or four pieces. Each artifact has one main stat and four random substats. The main stat scales with artifact level; substats gain rolls every five levels. Substats start with one base value and can receive up to five additional rolls, reaching six times the base value.
All of the stats below have an equal chance of being rolled. Mana related stats are not enhanced by artifacts.
Each piece of artifact has a specific main stat which cannot be overridden.
Custom artifact collections let a character swap between saved sets for different team compositions.
